privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At Turno Fácil, we are committed to protecting our users' privacy and handling their information responsibly.
privacyPolicy.informationIntro: When using Turno Fácil, we may collect the following information:
privacyPolicy.name: First and last name.
privacyPolicy.password: Password (stored encrypted and never in plain text).
privacyPolicy.businessData: Information related to businesses managed through the platform.
privacyPolicy.userData: Information about teachers, students, and appointments created by the user.
privacyPolicy.useIntro: Collected information is used only to:
privacyPolicy.manageBusinesses: Manage businesses, teachers, students, and appointments.
privacyPolicy.emails: Send verification and password recovery emails.
privacyPolicy.improveService: Improve the service's functionality and security.
privacyPolicy.sharingText: Turno Fácil does not sell or trade personal information. Some external services may process certain data to provide specific features, such as sending emails.
privacyPolicy.securityText: We implement security measures to protect stored information. Passwords are encrypted and cannot be recovered by Turno Fácil staff.
privacyPolicy.retentionText: Data will be stored while the account remains active or until the user requests its deletion, unless the law requires certain information to be retained.
privacyPolicy.deleteData: Request the deletion of their account and data where applicable.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText: Turno Fácil may use cookies needed to keep users signed in and improve the experience.
privacyPolicy.changesText: This Privacy Policy may be updated to reflect improvements or changes to the service.
privacyPolicy.contactText: If you have questions about this policy, you can contact the Turno Fácil team through the available contact channels.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By using Turno Fácil, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
terms.subjectText: Turno Fácil is a platform for managing appointments, students, teachers, and businesses.
terms.registrationText: Some features require an account with accurate and up-to-date information. Each user is responsible for keeping their credentials confidential.
terms.allowedText: Users agree to use the platform only for lawful purposes and in respect of the rights of others.
terms.prohibitedAccess: Attempting to access other users' information.
terms.prohibitedIllegal: Using the platform for unlawful activities.
terms.informationText: Each user is responsible for the data they enter in Turno Fácil, including information about students, teachers, and businesses.
terms.availabilityText: We strive to keep the service continuously available. However, interruptions may occur due to maintenance, updates, or causes beyond our control.
terms.changesText: Turno Fácil may add features, modify existing ones, or update these terms when necessary.
terms.accountRemovalText: We may remove accounts that violate these terms or misuse the platform.
terms.liabilityText: Turno Fácil is a management tool. Each business is responsible for the information it manages and how it organizes its activities.
terms.contactText: For questions about these terms, you can contact us through Turno Fácil's official channels.

home.hero: The easiest way to organize your business. Automate appointments, manage capacity, and manage students and teachers from any device.

features.customers: Easily manage your students with clear, organized information. Track status, attendance, and important details in one place.
features.appointments: Manage classes and bookings automatically. Your customers can book, cancel, or change appointments without contacting you.
features.payments: Keep track of your students' payments and plans. Manage subscriptions, due dates, and each customer's status, while allowing them to pay quickly and securely through the app.
features.reports: Get clear information about your business: attendance, active students, booked appointments, and more to make better decisions.
features.statistics: See how your business is performing with simple data on class occupancy, student growth, and system usage.
features.automation: Save time by automating repetitive tasks. Appointments, capacity, and daily management run effortlessly.
